system.description: Cast quickly compared to most rituals: the Necromancer performs a short, awkward dance for one turn, then bites through her own lip (one level of bashing damage) and spits blood in a three-pace circle around herself (spending one Blood Trait). Any ghost that enters the circle suffers a two-Trait resolution penalty on all challenges; any Risen entering the circle suffers a one-Trait penalty. Performance may be used as the retest Ability.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
